title: Korean-Style Crispy Zucchini Fritters
description: Crispy zucchini fritters seasoned with Korean spices, perfect as a keto snack or side dish. This recipe yields a crunchy exterior and a tender interior.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the grated zucchini, Korean chili flakes, flaky sea salt, and namul.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the coconut flour and egg.
Add the coconut flour mixture to the zucchini mixture and stir until combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the patties to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
Transfer the fritters to a baking sheet and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through.
